data.name: Asaafiyyat
data.gender_notes: Asaafiyyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who possesses softness, gentleness, grace, and calmness. The name Asaafiyyat carries the meaning “Softness, gentleness, grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asaafiyyat usually hope their child will grow to embody softness, gentleness, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle soul, one who embodies calmness and grace in her actions and demeanor
data.etymology: Asaafiyyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Softness, gentleness, grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asaafiyyat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أسافيات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الطهارة و النقاء و الصفاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أسافيات مشتق من الفعل 'أسفى' الذي يعني تطهير الشيء من النجاسة و العيوب. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنفال آية 11 'وَأَسَفَّى عَلَيْكُمْ مِّنَ الْغَيْثِ لِتَطَهَّرُوا' حيث يرتبط المعنى بالطهارة و النقاء. يستخدم الاسم للدلالة على الشخصية الطاهرة و النقية.

in_urdu.name: اسافیت
in_urdu.meaning: اس نام کا مطلب ہے صفائی، طہارت اور پاکیزگی
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسافیت نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کو نجاست اور عیوب سے پاک کرنا۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر انظارۃً کیا گیا ہے جہاں صفائی اور طہارت پر زور دیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام پاکیزگی اور تقویٰ کی علامت ہے جو مسلمانوں کے لئے اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: असाफियत
in_hindi.meaning: इस नाम का अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और स्वच्छता
in_hindi.long_meaning: असाफियत नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को अशुद्धि और दोषों से मुक्त करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में पवित्रता और शुद्धता का विशेष महत्व है और यह नाम इसी गुण को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए चुना जाता है जो पवित्र और शुद्ध स्वभाव के होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: اسافياټ
in_pashto.meaning: دې نوم مطلب د پاکۍ، طهارت او سپېدګۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسافياټ نوم د عربي کلمو څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د کوم چي پاکول د نجاست او بديو څخه مانا لري. په قرآن کريم کې داسې يادونه شوې ده چې پاکۍ او طهارت باندې ټينګار کوي. دا نوم د پاکۍ او پرهیزګارۍ نښه ده، کوم چې د مسلمانانو لپاره مهمه ده.

in_english.name: Asaafiyyat
in_english.meaning: This name means purity, cleanliness, and spirituality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asaafiyyat originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the term 'asafā', which means to cleanse or purify. Referenced in the Quran (Surah Al-Anfal, Verse 11), it emphasizes purification from impurities. The name symbolizes a person's pure heart and soul, reflecting spiritual cleanliness and moral integrity, highly valued in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asaafiyyat is of Arabic origin and its meaning reflects the cultural value of gentleness, softness, and grace in Islam. In a world filled with chaos, conflict, and harshness, this name serves as a reminder of the importance of kindness and compassion in our interactions with others. It encourages individuals to be calm and gentle, to exhibit patience and understanding, and to communicate effectively with empathy. In many Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, the practice of calligraphy holds significant importance, and the beautiful script of the name Asaafiyyat adds to its elegant and refined image.
data.spiritual_significance: Asaafiyyat, the possessor of softness and calmness, also carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims. In the Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was a mercy to all of humanity, and this merciful nature is an essential aspect of every believer. The name Asaafiyyat embodies this divine attribute and represents an individual's striving towards attaining emotional intelligence, compassion, and the ability to provide solace to those in need. It encourages individuals to seek inner peace and contentment and to be kind to others, as reflected in Prophet Muhammad's famous saying, "The strongest bond amongst people is love." By embodying the name Asaafiyyat, one may also aspire to develop a deeper connection with Allah, the most merciful and compassionate of all beings.
